q:
सूची-I (पद्म विभूषण 2026 विजेता) को सूची-II (योगदान क्षेत्र) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I:
1. धर्मेंद्र
2. एन. राजम
3. के.टी. थॉमस
4. पी. नारायणन
सूची-II:
(a) कला (हिंदुस्तानी शास्त्रीय वायलिन)
(b) साहित्य एवं शिक्षा
(c) कला (भारतीय सिनेमा)
(d) लोक कार्य (Public Affairs)
e:
All 5 Padma Vibhushan 2026 recipients: Dharmendra (Art — Cinema), N. Rajam (Art — Violin), K.T. Thomas (Public Affairs), P. Narayanan (Literature & Education), and V.S. Achuthanandan (Public Affairs).
पद्म विभूषण 2026 के पाँचों विजेताओं में सही सुमेलन 1-(c), 2-(a), 3-(d), 4-(b) है।
Booster Facts: (1) Padma Awards were instituted in 1954 and are announced annually on Republic Day eve (25 Jan). (2) Hierarchy of civilian awards: Bharat Ratna > Padma Vibhushan > Padma Bhushan > Padma Shri.
qe:
Match List-I (Padma Vibhushan 2026 Recipient) with List-II (Field of Contribution):
List-I:
1. Dharmendra
2. N. Rajam
3. K.T. Thomas
4. P. Narayanan
List-II:
(a) Art (Hindustani Classical Violin)
(b) Literature and Education
(c) Art (Indian Cinema)
(d) Public Affairs

q:
2026 में घोषित भारत के सर्वोच्च सिनेमा और साहित्य सम्मानों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: दिग्गज अभिनेता अनंत नाग को सितंबर 2026 में दादासाहेब फाल्के पुरस्कार (2024 हेतु) से सम्मानित किया गया।
कथन II: तमिल कवि-गीतकार आर. वैरामुत्तु को मार्च 2026 में 60वें ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are factually verified: Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2024 (Sept 2026), and R. Vairamuthu won the 60th Jnanpith Award (March 2026).
कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) First Dadasaheb Phalke Award (1969): Devika Rani. (2) First Jnanpith Award (1965): G. Sankara Kurup (Malayalam). (3) Jnanpith Award is given for the 22 Eighth Schedule languages + English.
qe:
Consider the following two statements regarding India's highest cinema and literary honours announced in 2026:
Statement I: Veteran actor Anant Nag was conferred the Dadasaheb Phalke Award (for 2024) in September 2026.
Statement II: Tamil poet-lyricist R. Vairamuthu was honoured with the 60th Jnanpith Award in March 2026.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में उत्तर प्रदेश की ₹1,725 करोड़ की कौशल प्रशिक्षण योजना के साथ 'प्रगति (PRAGATI) रोबोटिक्स पार्क' कहाँ स्थापित/लॉन्च किया गया?
e:
The PRAGATI Robotics Park was launched in Greater Noida (Gautam Buddh Nagar) in October 2026, alongside Uttar Pradesh's ₹1,725 crore Skill Training Scheme to boost advanced manufacturing and youth employability.
प्रगति रोबोटिक्स पार्क ग्रेटर नोएडा (उत्तर प्रदेश) में लॉन्च किया गया।
Booster Facts: (1) Greater Noida & Noida (YEIDA region) form UP's primary electronics, robotics, and semiconductor hub. (2) Uttar Pradesh Skill Development Mission (UPSDM) coordinates vocational training across all 75 districts.
qe: In October 2026, where in Uttar Pradesh was the PRAGATI Robotics Park launched alongside the state's ₹1,725 crore Skill Training Scheme?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में भारत के किन दो उपग्रहों ने क्रमशः अगली पीढ़ी के क्षेत्रीय नेविगेशन (NavIC) और समर्पित रक्षा संचार क्षमताओं के लिए सुर्खियाँ बटोरीं?
e:
ISRO's NVS-03 (third in the NVS-01/02/03 second-generation NavIC constellation) strengthens indigenous navigation, while GSAT-7C is a dedicated defence communication satellite (Oct 2026).
NVS-03 नेविगेशन (NavIC) तथा GSAT-7C रक्षा संचार उपग्रह हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) NavIC = Navigation with Indian Constellation (7-satellite regional GPS system covering India + 1,500 km around). (2) ISRO was founded on 15 August 1969; headquarters: Bengaluru.
qe: Which pair of Indian satellites made headlines in October 2026, representing India's next-generation regional navigation (NavIC) and dedicated defence communication capabilities respectively?

q: नवंबर 2026 में भारत का कौन-सा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश देश का पहला पूर्ण जैविक केंद्र शासित प्रदेश (1st Organic UT) बना (राष्ट्रीय केसर मिशन जैसी पहलों के साथ)?
e:
Ladakh achieved the distinction of becoming India's first fully Organic Union Territory in November 2026 (while Sikkim was India's first fully Organic State in 2016).
नवंबर 2026 में लद्दाख भारत का पहला पूर्ण जैविक केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बना।
Booster Facts: (1) National Saffron Mission promotes high-value saffron cultivation (notably Pampore, Kashmir — GI-tagged). (2) Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) promotes organic farming nationwide.
qe: In November 2026, which Union Territory of India became the country's first fully Organic Union Territory (alongside initiatives like the National Saffron Mission)?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में किस केंद्र शासित प्रदेश ने ULLAS (नव भारत साक्षरता कार्यक्रम) योजना के अंतर्गत पूर्ण साक्षरता हासिल की, जिसके साथ शिक्षा मंत्रालय के 5 शास्त्रीय भाषा उत्कृष्टता केंद्र (CoEs) भी चर्चा में रहे?
e:
Lakshadweep achieved full functional literacy under ULLAS (Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society) in October 2026, alongside MoE establishing 5 Centres of Excellence for Classical Languages.
अक्टूबर 2026 में लक्षद्वीप ने ULLAS के अंतर्गत पूर्ण साक्षरता प्राप्त की।
Booster Facts: (1) ULLAS (2022–2027) targets foundational literacy & numeracy for non-literate adults aged 15+. (2) India now has 11 Classical Languages (original 6: Tamil, Sanskrit, Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam, Odia + 5 added in Oct 2024: Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, Bengali).
qe: In October 2026, which Union Territory achieved 100% functional literacy under the ULLAS (Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram) scheme, coinciding with MoE's rollout of 5 Classical Languages Centres of Excellence?

q: प्रशासनिक दृष्टि से उत्तर प्रदेश कितने मंडलों (Divisions) और जिलों (Janpads) में विभाजित है?
e:
Uttar Pradesh comprises 18 administrative divisions (mandals) and 75 districts (janpads). Aligarh was created as the 18th division in 2008.
उत्तर प्रदेश में 18 मंडल और 75 जिले हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) Largest district by area: Lakhimpur Kheri; Smallest district by area: Hapur. (2) Most populous district (Census 2011): Prayagraj; Least populous: Mahoba.
qe: Administratively, Uttar Pradesh is divided into how many Divisions (Mandal) and Districts (Janpad)?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के किस बौद्ध तीर्थ स्थल पर गौतम बुद्ध ने अपना प्रथम उपदेश ('धर्मचक्रप्रवर्तन') दिया था?
e:
Gautama Buddha delivered his first sermon at Deer Park (Rishipatana) in Sarnath, near Varanasi (UP), where the Dhamek Stupa and Ashoka's Lion Capital (India's National Emblem) are located.
गौतम बुद्ध ने अपना प्रथम उपदेश सारनाथ (वाराणसी के निकट) में दिया था।
Booster Facts: (1) Kushinagar (UP) is where Buddha attained Mahaparinirvana. (2) Shravasti (UP) is where Buddha spent the maximum number of monsoon retreats (Varshavas) and gave the most sermons.
qe: At which Buddhist pilgrimage site in Uttar Pradesh did Gautama Buddha deliver his first sermon ('Dhammachakkappavattana')?

q: निम्नलिखित में से किन प्रमुख कृषि फसलों के उत्पादन में उत्तर प्रदेश का भारत में प्रथम स्थान है?
e:
Uttar Pradesh is India's largest producer of Wheat, Sugarcane, Potatoes, and Milk, earning it the title 'Sugar Bowl of India'.
गेहूँ और गन्ना (साथ ही आलू व दुग्ध) उत्पादन में उत्तर प्रदेश देश में प्रथम स्थान पर है।
Booster Facts: (1) Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR) is in Lucknow; National Sugar Institute (NSI) is in Kanpur. (2) Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) is in Kanpur; Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI) is in Izatnagar, Bareilly.
qe: Uttar Pradesh ranks FIRST in India in the production of which of the following pairs of major agricultural crops?

q: हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन (HSRA) से जुड़े किस प्रसिद्ध क्रांतिकारी ने 27 फरवरी 1931 को प्रयागराज (इलाहाबाद) के अल्फ्रेड पार्क में शहादत प्राप्त की थी?
e:
Chandrashekhar Azad fought British police single-handedly and attained martyrdom at Alfred Park (now Chandrashekhar Azad Park), Prayagraj on 27 February 1931.
चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद 27 फरवरी 1931 को प्रयागराज के अल्फ्रेड पार्क में शहीद हुए थे।
Booster Facts: (1) Kakori Train Action (9 Aug 1925) martyrs hanged in UP: Ram Prasad Bismil (Gorakhpur Jail), Ashfaqulla Khan (Faizabad/Ayodhya Jail), Roshan Singh (Naini Jail, Prayagraj), Rajendra Lahiri (Gonda Jail).
qe: Which famous freedom fighter and revolutionary associated with the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) attained martyrdom on 27 February 1931 at Alfred Park in Prayagraj (Allahabad)?

q:
सूची-I (उत्तर प्रदेश के सांस्कृतिक/शैक्षिक संस्थान) को सूची-II (स्थान) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I:
1. भारत कला भवन
2. भातखंडे संस्कृति विश्वविद्यालय
3. केंद्रीय उच्च तिब्बती शिक्षा संस्थान
4. मोतीलाल नेहरू राष्ट्रीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान (MNNIT)
सूची-II:
(a) लखनऊ
(b) प्रयागराज
(c) सारनाथ (वाराणसी)
(d) बीएचयू, वाराणसी
e:
Bharat Kala Bhavan = BHU, Varanasi (1920, Rai Krishnadasa); Bhatkhande Music University = Lucknow (1926); Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies = Sarnath; MNNIT = Prayagraj.
सही सुमेलन 1-(d), 2-(a), 3-(c), 4-(b) है।
Booster Facts: (1) Bharat Bhavan is in Bhopal (MP), whereas Bharat Kala Bhavan is in Varanasi (UP) — a classic exam trap!
qe:
Match List-I (Cultural Institution in UP) with List-II (Location):
List-I:
1. Bharat Kala Bhavan
2. Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya
3. Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies
4. Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology (MNNIT)
List-II:
(a) Lucknow
(b) Prayagraj
(c) Sarnath (Varanasi)
(d) BHU, Varanasi

q: भारत का राष्ट्रीय आदर्श वाक्य 'सत्यमेव जयते' किस प्राचीन उपनिषद से लिया गया है?
e:
'Satyameva Jayate' is inscribed below the National Emblem in Devanagari script and originates from the Mundaka Upanishad (associated with the Atharvaveda).
'सत्यमेव जयते' मुण्डकोपनिषद से लिया गया है।
Booster Facts: (1) Katha Upanishad contains the famous Yama–Nachiketa dialogue. (2) Gayatri Mantra appears in the 3rd Mandala of the Rigveda (composed by Vishwamitra).
qe: The national motto of India, 'Satyameva Jayate' (Truth Alone Triumphs), is taken from which ancient Upanishad?

q: किस गुप्त शासक को उसके सोने के सिक्कों पर वीणा बजाते हुए दर्शाया गया है, जिसे 'कविराज' की उपाधि दी गई और इतिहासकार वी.ए. स्मिथ ने 'भारत का नेपोलियन' कहा?
e:
Samudragupta (c. 335–375 CE) is glorified in the Prayag Prashasti (Allahabad Pillar Inscription) composed by his court poet Harishena. His gold coins depict him playing the Veena.
समुद्रगुप्त को 'कविराज' तथा 'भारत का नेपोलियन' कहा जाता है।
Booster Facts: (1) Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya) had the Navaratnas (including Kalidasa) in his court and welcomed Chinese pilgrim Fa-Hien. (2) Nalanda University was founded by Kumaragupta I.
qe: Which Gupta ruler was titled 'Kaviraja' (King of Poets) on his gold coins depicting him playing the Veena, and was called the 'Napoleon of India' by historian V.A. Smith?

q: भारत के किस मध्यकालीन शासक ने मानक चाँदी का सिक्का 'रुपया' (178 ग्रेन) चलाया तथा ऐतिहासिक सड़क-ए-आज़म (ग्रैंड ट्रंक रोड) का निर्माण कराया?
e:
Sher Shah Suri (1540–1545) introduced the silver Rupiya, copper Dam, Patta & Qabuliyat land revenue system, and rebuilt the Grand Trunk Road from Sonargaon (Bengal) to Peshawar.
शेरशाह सूरी ने चाँदी का 'रुपया' चलाया और ग्रैंड ट्रंक रोड का निर्माण कराया।
Booster Facts: (1) Sher Shah's octagonal tomb is located at Sasaram (Bihar). (2) He died in 1545 during the siege of Kalinjar Fort (Banda, UP).
qe: Which medieval ruler of India introduced the standardized silver coin 'Rupiya' (178 grains) and constructed the historic Sadak-e-Azam (Grand Trunk Road)?

q: भारत के किस गवर्नर-जनरल ने 'व्यपगत का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Lapse) लागू किया, जिसके अंतर्गत सतारा (1848), झाँसी (1853) और नागपुर (1854) को ब्रिटिश साम्राज्य में मिलाया गया?
e:
Lord Dalhousie (1848–1856) implemented the Doctrine of Lapse (annexing Satara, Jaitpur, Sambalpur, Baghat, Udaipur, Jhansi, Nagpur) and annexed Awadh (1856) on grounds of misgovernance.
लॉर्ड डलहौजी ने व्यपगत का सिद्धांत लागू किया था।
Booster Facts: (1) Lord Wellesley introduced the Subsidiary Alliance (1798, first signed by Nizam of Hyderabad). (2) Lord Dalhousie also started India's first railway (Bombay–Thane, 1853), telegraph, and postal stamp system.
qe: Which Governor-General of India introduced the 'Doctrine of Lapse' (व्यपगत का सिद्धांत), under which Satara (1848), Jhansi (1853), and Nagpur (1854) were annexed?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन ब्रिटिश कैबिनेट मिशन (1946) का सदस्य नहीं था, जिसने भारत की संविधान सभा की रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत की थी?
e:
The Cabinet Mission (March 1946) comprised three British cabinet ministers: Lord Pethick-Lawrence (Chairman), Sir Stafford Cripps, and A.V. Alexander. Lord Mountbatten arrived later in March 1947 as the last Viceroy.
लॉर्ड माउंटबेटन कैबिनेट मिशन (1946) के सदस्य नहीं थे।
Booster Facts: (1) Based on the Cabinet Mission Plan, the Constituent Assembly held its first meeting on 9 December 1946 (Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha as temporary Chairman; Dr. Rajendra Prasad elected permanent President on 11 Dec 1946).
qe: Who among the following was NOT a member of the British Cabinet Mission (1946) that proposed the framework for India's Constituent Assembly?

q: 42वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1976 द्वारा भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना में कौन-से तीन शब्द जोड़े गए थे?
e:
The 42nd Amendment Act, 1976 (often called the 'Mini Constitution') amended the Preamble for the only time so far, inserting 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity'.
42वें संशोधन (1976) द्वारा प्रस्तावना में समाजवादी, पंथनिरपेक्ष और अखंडता शब्द जोड़े गए।
Booster Facts: (1) In Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973), the Supreme Court held that the Preamble is part of the Constitution and established the Basic Structure Doctrine.
qe: Which three words were added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976?

q: शिक्षा आयोग (1964–66), जिसने 10+2+3 शैक्षिक संरचना तथा शिक्षा पर राष्ट्रीय आय का 6% व्यय करने की सिफारिश की थी, के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e:
The Kothari Commission (1964–66), chaired by Dr. Daulat Singh Kothari, laid the blueprint for India's first National Policy on Education (1968), the 10+2+3 pattern, Three-Language Formula, and the 6% GDP target.
कोठारी आयोग (1964–66) के अध्यक्ष डॉ. डी.एस. कोठारी थे।
Booster Facts: (1) Radhakrishnan Commission (1948–49) = University Education Commission (led to UGC). (2) Mudaliar Commission (1952–53) = Secondary Education Commission. (3) K. Kasturirangan Committee drafted NEP 2020.
qe: The Education Commission (1964–66), which recommended the 10+2+3 educational structure and allocating 6% of national income (GDP) to education, was chaired by:

q: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 के अंतर्गत वर्तमान 10+2 स्कूली पाठ्यक्रम संरचना को किस नई शैक्षणिक संरचना से प्रतिस्थापित किया गया है?
e:
NEP 2020 introduces the 5 + 3 + 3 + 4 curricular structure covering ages 3–18: Foundational (5 yrs: 3 yrs Anganwadi/Balvatika + Classes 1–2), Preparatory (3 yrs: Classes 3–5), Middle (3 yrs: Classes 6–8), and Secondary (4 yrs: Classes 9–12).
NEP 2020 में नई संरचना 5 + 3 + 3 + 4 है।
Booster Facts: (1) NEP 2020 aims for 100% Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in school education by 2030 and 50% GER in higher education by 2035. (2) Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD) was renamed Ministry of Education (MoE) in 2020.
qe: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, the existing 10+2 school curricular structure is replaced by which new pedagogical structure?

q: भारतीय संविधान में 1976 में मौलिक कर्तव्य (भाग IVA, अनुच्छेद 51A) किस समिति की सिफारिश पर शामिल किए गए थे?
e:
On the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee, the 42nd Amendment Act (1976) inserted Part IVA (Article 51A) with 10 Fundamental Duties (borrowed from the USSR Constitution). The 11th duty (51A(k) — education) was added by the 86th Amendment (2002).
स्वर्ण सिंह समिति की सिफारिश पर मौलिक कर्तव्य संविधान में जोड़े गए।
Booster Facts: (1) J.S. Verma Committee (1999) identified legal provisions for implementing Fundamental Duties. (2) Sarkaria Commission (1983) dealt with Centre-State relations.
qe: Fundamental Duties (Part IVA, Article 51A) were incorporated into the Indian Constitution in 1976 on the recommendation of which committee?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 280 के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रपति द्वारा प्रत्येक पाँच वर्ष में वित्त आयोग का गठन किसकी सिफारिश करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Monetary policy repo rate and inflation targets
Salary revision of Central Government employees
Delimitation of Lok Sabha and Assembly constituencies
Distribution of net proceeds of taxes between the Union and the States and grants-in-aid
e:
Under Article 280, the Finance Commission is a quasi-judicial constitutional body that recommends vertical and horizontal devolution of central taxes between the Union and States, and grants-in-aid under Article 275.
अनुच्छेद 280 के तहत वित्त आयोग संघ और राज्यों के बीच करों के शुद्ध आगमों के वितरण तथा सहायता अनुदान की सिफारिश करता है।
Booster Facts: (1) 1st Finance Commission Chairman: K.C. Neogy (1951). (2) 16th Finance Commission (for 2026–31) was chaired by Dr. Arvind Panagariya.
qe: Under Article 280 of the Constitution of India, the Finance Commission is constituted by the President every five years to recommend:
oe: Monetary policy repo rate and inflation targets
Salary revision of Central Government employees
Delimitation of Lok Sabha and Assembly constituencies
Distribution of net proceeds of taxes between the Union and the States and grants-in-aid

q: प्रायद्वीपीय भारत की कौन-सी दो प्रमुख नदियाँ भ्रंश घाटी (rift valley) से होकर पश्चिम की ओर बहती हैं और डेल्टा बनाए बिना अरब सागर में गिरती हैं?
e:
Narmada (originating at Amarkantak) and Tapi (originating at Multai, Betul) flow westward through rift valleys between Vindhya–Satpura–Ajanta ranges and form estuaries (not deltas) in the Arabian Sea.
नर्मदा और तापी भ्रंश घाटी से होकर पश्चिम की ओर बहती हैं और ज्वारनदमुख (estuary) बनाती हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) East-flowing rivers (Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Kaveri) form fertile deltas in the Bay of Bengal. (2) Dhuandhar Falls (Jabalpur) is on the Narmada River.
qe: Which pair of major Peninsular Indian rivers flows WESTWARD through rift valleys and drains into the Arabian Sea without forming a delta?

q: यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल 'काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान' (असम) विश्व स्तर पर किस संकटग्रस्त प्रजाति की सबसे बड़ी आबादी के संरक्षण के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e:
Kaziranga National Park (on the Brahmaputra floodplains, Assam) hosts over two-thirds of the world's Greater One-Horned Rhinoceros population.
काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान एक सींग वाले गैंडे (One-Horned Rhinoceros) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
Booster Facts: (1) Asiatic Lion = Gir National Park (Gujarat). (2) Hangul = Dachigam National Park (J&K). (3) Sangai (dancing deer) = Keibul Lamjao National Park (Manipur — world's only floating national park).
qe: Kaziranga National Park (Assam), a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is globally renowned for conserving the largest population of which endangered species?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत के किन राज्यों में क्रमशः सर्वाधिक और न्यूनतम कुल साक्षरता दर दर्ज की गई?
e:
In Census 2011, Kerala had the highest literacy rate (94.00%, followed by Lakshadweep 91.85% & Mizoram 91.33%) and Bihar had the lowest (61.80%, followed by Arunachal Pradesh 65.38% & Rajasthan 66.11%).
जनगणना 2011 में सर्वाधिक साक्षरता केरल (94.00%) और न्यूनतम बिहार (61.80%) की थी।
Booster Facts: (1) India's overall literacy rate in 2011 was 74.04% (Male 82.14%, Female 65.46%). (2) In UP, highest literacy district: Gautam Buddh Nagar; lowest: Shravasti.
qe: According to Census 2011, which Indian states recorded the HIGHEST and LOWEST overall literacy rates respectively?

q: भारत में प्रतिभूति और पूँजी बाजार (जैसे NSE और BSE स्टॉक एक्सचेंज) का विनियमन कौन-सा सांविधिक निकाय करता है?
e:
SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India, headquarters: Mumbai) was established in 1988 and given statutory status via the SEBI Act, 1992 to protect investors and regulate capital markets.
SEBI भारत के पूँजी व शेयर बाजार का नियामक है।
Booster Facts: (1) IRDAI regulates Insurance (HQ: Hyderabad); PFRDA regulates Pension (NPS); TRAI regulates Telecom. (2) BSE (1875) is Asia's oldest stock exchange; its benchmark index is SENSEX (30 stocks); NSE's index is NIFTY 50.
qe: Which statutory body regulates the securities and capital markets (stock exchanges like NSE and BSE) in India?

q: 1960 के दशक में उच्च उपज वाली गेहूँ की किस्में पेश करने के लिए किसे 'भारत में हरित क्रांति का जनक' कहा जाता है (जिन्हें 2024 में मरणोपरांत भारत रत्न प्रदान किया गया)?
e:
Dr. M.S. Swaminathan led India's Green Revolution (focusing on HYV seeds of wheat and rice, irrigation, and fertilizers) and received the Bharat Ratna in 2024.
डॉ. एम.एस. स्वामीनाथन भारत में हरित क्रांति के जनक हैं।
Booster Facts: (1) Norman Borlaug = Father of World Green Revolution (Nobel Peace Prize 1970). (2) Verghese Kurien = Father of White Revolution (Operation Flood / Milk). (3) Hiralal Chaudhuri = Blue Revolution (Fisheries).
qe: Who is honoured as the 'Father of the Green Revolution in India' (conferred the Bharat Ratna posthumously in 2024) for introducing high-yielding wheat varieties in the 1960s?

q: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (MGNREGA), 2005 के अंतर्गत प्रत्येक ग्रामीण परिवार को, जिसके वयस्क सदस्य स्वेच्छा से अकुशल शारीरिक श्रम करने को तैयार हैं, एक वित्तीय वर्ष में कितने दिनों के रोजगार की कानूनी गारंटी दी जाती है?
e:
MGNREGA (enacted Sept 2005, launched 2 Feb 2006 from Anantapur, AP; renamed MGNREGA in 2009) legally guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment per financial year to every rural household, with at least 1/3rd participation reserved for women.
मनरेगा (2005) के तहत प्रति वित्तीय वर्ष 100 दिनों के अकुशल रोजगार की कानूनी गारंटी है।
Booster Facts: (1) If work is not provided within 15 days of application, the applicant is entitled to an unemployment allowance. (2) Gram Sabha conducts Social Audits of MGNREGA works.
qe: Under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), 2005, how many days of guaranteed unskilled wage employment per financial year are legally assured to every rural household whose adult members volunteer?

q: हरे पौधों में प्रकाश-संश्लेषण के लिए आवश्यक क्लोरोफिल (पर्णहरित) अणु के केंद्र में कौन-सा धात्विक तत्व उपस्थित होता है?
e:
Magnesium (Mg) is the central metal atom in the porphyrin ring of Chlorophyll. (Iron is the central atom in Haemoglobin; Cobalt is in Vitamin B12.)
क्लोरोफिल के केंद्र में मैग्नीशियम (Mg) तत्व पाया जाता है।
Booster Facts: (1) Photosynthesis equation: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ (in presence of sunlight & chlorophyll). (2) Light reaction occurs in Grana (thylakoids); Dark reaction (Calvin cycle) occurs in Stroma of chloroplasts.
qe: Which metallic element is present at the centre of the Chlorophyll molecule, essential for photosynthesis in green plants?

q: वाहनों में पश्च-दृश्य दर्पण (rear-view mirror) के रूप में किस प्रकार के गोलीय दर्पण का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह सदैव आभासी, सीधा और छोटा प्रतिबिंब बनाकर विस्तृत दृष्टि क्षेत्र प्रदान करता है?
e:
A Convex Mirror always produces an erect, virtual, and diminished image regardless of object distance, offering a wide field of view for vehicle rear-view mirrors.
वाहनों के पश्च-दृश्य दर्पण में उत्तल दर्पण (Convex Mirror) का प्रयोग होता है।
Booster Facts: (1) Concave mirrors are used in vehicle headlights, shaving mirrors, dentists' mirrors, and solar furnaces. (2) Myopia (near-sightedness) is corrected by a Concave lens; Hypermetropia (far-sightedness) by a Convex lens.
qe: Which type of spherical mirror is used as a rear-view mirror in vehicles because it always forms a virtual, erect, and diminished image with a wider field of view?

q: कंप्यूटर नेटवर्क में कौन-सा प्रोटोकॉल मानव-पठनीय वेबसाइट डोमेन नामों (जैसे www.ncert.nic.in) को मशीन-पठनीय संख्यात्मक IP एड्रेस में परिवर्तित करता है?
e:
DNS (Domain Name System, Port 53) acts as the directory/phonebook of the Internet, resolving domain names into IPv4/IPv6 addresses.
DNS (डोमेन नेम सिस्टम) डोमेन नाम को IP एड्रेस में बदलता है।
Booster Facts: (1) HTTP (Port 80) / HTTPS (Port 443) = Web page transfer. (2) SMTP (Port 25) = Outgoing email. (3) FTP (Port 21) = File transfer.
qe: In computer networks, which protocol translates human-readable website domain names (like www.ncert.nic.in) into machine-readable numerical IP addresses?
